title: Engeyum Kadhal
desc: Kayal, a cellist in Paris, falls in love with Kamal at first sight and saves him from possible death. However, she gets disheartened when she learns that he does not reciprocate her feelings.

title: Kadhalan
desc: A college student falls in love with the daughter of a powerful governor. When the latter gets a whiff of the affair, he tries to put a stop to it.

title: Vallavan
desc: Vallavan loves Swapna even though she is three years older than him. Although she reciprocates initially, the age difference and his past with a classmate create tensions in their relationship.

title: Vettaiyaadu Vilaiyaadu
desc: The tragic death of his friend's child leads Raghavan into a complex investigation. With the killer on the run, Raghavan faces immense pressure to apprehend him before the situation escalates.

title: Devathayai Kandaein
desc: A tea seller deeply in love faces heartbreak when the woman he adores chooses a wealthier match, pushing him to seek justice in a unique and emotional way.
